name: Wave 3 from the end of wave 2
idea: In wave 2 of an impulse that stayed inside the start of wave 1, a signal on the first close beyond the last smaller swing of wave 2 (or the end of wave 1). The mirror: a falling impulse. Wrong beyond the start of wave 1. The count is an interpretation.

params.label: Wave size (swing degree the waves are counted at)
params.help: Which swings count as waves: 1 is the smallest, 3 the largest. Larger waves need more history. Reference: 1.

params.label: Bars for the average true range
params.help: Bars for the average true range the break distance is measured in. Reference: 14.

params.label: Break distance beyond a level, in average true ranges (0: any close beyond)
params.help: How far beyond the level a close must be, in average true ranges (0 means any close beyond). Reference: 0.

params.label: Bars a setup stays watched after the count moves on
params.help: After the count moves on, how many bars the setup is still watched for its close beyond the level. Reference: 20.

params.label: Wave 3 trigger: the last smaller swing of wave 2, or the end of wave 1
params.help: The level the close must go beyond: the last smaller swing of wave 2 (none there: the end of wave 1), or always the end of wave 1 (later, more patient).
choice_labels: The last smaller swing of wave 2

params.label: Only when wave 2 is inside the depth zone
params.help: Optional: only when wave 2 retraced wave 1 inside the depth zone below.

params.label: Wave 2 depth zone: from (share of wave 1)
params.help: The near edge of the wave 2 depth zone, as a share of wave 1. Reference: 0.5.

params.label: Wave 2 depth zone: to (share of wave 1)
params.help: The far edge of the wave 2 depth zone, as a share of wave 1. Reference: 0.786.

params.label: Wave 3 idea void beyond
params.help: Where the idea is wrong: beyond the start of wave 1 (the count's own rule), or beyond the extreme of wave 2.

constraints.message: The wave 2 depth zone must start before it ends.

setup.long: FibEw("wave3_entry", "up", degree=$degree, atr_n=$atr_n, break_k=$break_k, expiry=$expiry, w3_trigger=$w3_trigger, w2_zone=$w2_zone, w2_min=$w2_min, w2_max=$w2_max, w3_void=$w3_void)
setup.short: FibEw("wave3_entry", "down", degree=$degree, atr_n=$atr_n, break_k=$break_k, expiry=$expiry, w3_trigger=$w3_trigger, w2_zone=$w2_zone, w2_min=$w2_min, w2_max=$w2_max, w3_void=$w3_void)

invalidation.long: FibEwLevel("wave3_void", degree=$degree, atr_n=$atr_n, break_k=$break_k, expiry=$expiry, w3_trigger=$w3_trigger, w2_zone=$w2_zone, w2_min=$w2_min, w2_max=$w2_max, w3_void=$w3_void)
invalidation.short: FibEwLevel("wave3_void", degree=$degree, atr_n=$atr_n, break_k=$break_k, expiry=$expiry, w3_trigger=$w3_trigger, w2_zone=$w2_zone, w2_min=$w2_min, w2_max=$w2_max, w3_void=$w3_void)
